original_value: We proposed a new efficient image denoising scheme, which leads to four important contributions. The first is to integrate both reconstruction and learning based approaches into a single model so that we are able to benefit advantages from both approaches simultaneously. The second is to handle both multiplicative and additive noise removal problems. The third is that the proposed approach introduces a sparse term to reduce non-Gaussian outliers from multiplicative noise and uses a Laplacian Schatten norm to capture the global structure information. In addition, the image is represented by preserving the intrinsic local similarity via a sparse coding method, which allows our model to incorporate both global and local information from the image. Finally, we propose a new method that combines Method of Optimal Directions (MOD) with Approximate K-SVD (AK-SVD) for dictionary learning. Extensive experimental results show that the proposed scheme is competitive against some of the state-of-the-art denoising algorithms.

result.paraphrase: We propose a new efficient image denoising scheme with four key contributions. First, it unifies reconstruction-based and learning-based approaches in a single model, allowing both advantages to be leveraged at once. Second, it addresses both multiplicative and additive noise removal. Third, the method adds a sparse term to suppress non-Gaussian outliers in multiplicative noise and employs the Laplacian Schatten norm to model global structural information; moreover, it represents images through sparse coding that preserves intrinsic local similarity, enabling the model to incorporate both global and local image information. Finally, we introduce a new dictionary-learning method that combines Method of Optimal Directions (MOD) with Approximate K-SVD (AK-SVD). Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed scheme is competitive with several state-of-the-art denoising algorithms.
